title: Higher-order structure of Hamiltonian truncation effective theory
summary: We study the Hamiltonian truncation for the two-dimensional $λφ^4$ theory within the framework of Hamiltonian truncation effective theory, where truncation artifacts are mitigated through a systematic inclusion of corrective terms organized in inverse powers of the ultraviolet energy cut-off $E_{\rm max}$. Building on the leading-order matching program, we develop two complementary extensions.
